ci_counts AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT ci.movie_id, COUNT(*)::HUGEINT AS n FROM cast_info ci JOIN selected_titles eligible ON eligible.id=ci.movie_id WHERE TRUE GROUP BY ci.movie_id),
mc_counts AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mc.movie_id, COUNT(*)::HUGEINT AS n FROM movie_companies mc JOIN selected_titles eligible ON eligible.id=mc.movie_id WHERE TRUE GROUP BY mc.movie_id),
mk_counts AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mk.movie_id, COUNT(*)::HUGEINT AS n FROM movie_keyword mk JOIN selected_titles eligible ON eligible.id=mk.movie_id WHERE mk.keyword_id=117 GROUP BY mk.movie_id)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ci.n * mc.n * mk.n),0) FROM selected_titles t JOIN ci_counts ci ON ci.movie_id=t.id JOIN mc_counts mc ON mc.movie_id=t.id JOIN mk_counts mk ON mk.movie_id=t.id;
